title: G38 · 拒绝
body: Generation 38 keeps the proven exact-safe matrix semantics while adding two independent summation lanes per 2×2 output, allowing eight FMA chains to hide FMA latency without adding tile register pressure; it also folds the matrix safety scan into transposition, replaces word-selection pair allocations with count buckets, and uses a direct finite-number sort for topK. These changes target the three lowest-speedup tasks while preserving fallback arithmetic and tie semantics, so the expected aggregate improvement should exceed the required 5% margin.
